annotations.title: Google Business attributes available for a listing

description: The ATTRIBUTES a Business Profile can set — accessibility, amenities, service options, payment types — with the valid values for each. These are what local searchers FILTER on, so a listing with none set is invisible to those filters. Scope it ONE of three ways: locationName (`locations/123`) alone for what THAT listing may set; categoryName (`categories/gcid:…`, from list_business_categories) for a category, where regionCode and languageCode are filled from the brand’s listing if left out (the reply says so); or regionCode with showAll:true for a country. locationName with the others is refused by name. Read-only, 0 credits. Needs Google Business Profile connected.

languageCode.description: BCP 47 language code; defaults to the listing’s

locationId.description: which listing to borrow regionCode/languageCode from when several are shared

pageToken.description: next page token from the previous reply

regionCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code; with categoryName, defaults to the listing’s

showAll.description: true = send Google's showAll flag for the full attribute list
